test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c0007626886e766d397481368f2272d709bef5013793f33b247808b9cc6ab18.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

**(First number in square box)¹/² = (Second number in square box) **

**(Second number in square box) × (Second number in square box + 2) = Number in circle** 

⇒ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6457c5ad8e56c4b7211122da2917c34eb363dc9ff607c15983b53b7d6abf8899.png] → 3 × (3 + 2) = 3 × 5 = 15

⇒ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59ec39c4b000f2132cf0bbd37f0f1cda4073d03dbb8684f5d13d295703df216a.png] → 4 × (4 + 2) = 4 × 6 = 24

⇒ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f9ac6430af35ed2348dcac00184aeb0f1bddf0423934882b12eb357e44b34d0.png] → 5 × (5 + 2) = 5 × 7 = **35**

Hence, **option 4)** is the correct answer.
